questions.content:
For the reaction P B, the values of frequency factor A and activation energy EA are 4 1013 s1 and 8.3 kJ mol1 respectively. If the reaction is of first order, the temperature at which the rate constant is 2 106 s1 is _____________ 101 K.

(Given : ln 10 = 2.3, R = 8.3 J K1 mol1, log2 = 0.30)
